$comment: Curation manifest for the @qball-inc/react icon system. Single source of truth for scripts/generate-icons.mjs and the icons contract test. `name` is the CANONICAL lucide kebab id. `alias` records a friendly lucide alias-stub name that re-exports the same glyph (e.g. filter -> funnel); it is re-exported as a named alias and keyed in the registry. `exportName` overrides the default PascalCase named export when it would collide with an existing non-icon component (e.g. the `search` icon vs the Search input primitive). WP-B-4b.2-B1 ships this curated slice; WP-B-4b.2-B2 expands to the full 76 UI set + the AI and Brand tracks. Every shipped name is a 1.0 stability contract.
